construct: Recoverable correspondence among observable requirements, artifacts, activities, decisions, repairs, and outcomes; not hidden reasoning, correctness, safety, task success, human benefit, or ontology superiority.

dimensions.unit: Each required artifact-reference slot in an arm-neutral observer-inventoried activity.
dimensions.positive_anchor: Exact source/version and locator verify every required identity/activity relationship.
dimensions.complete_chain_numerator: n_01 = applicable slots whose every required TR01 link is verified
dimensions.complete_chain_denominator: N_01 = all applicable slots required by the frozen stage schema in the neutral activity inventory

dimensions.unit: Each observable decision, with coding decisions and game-action decisions reported separately.
dimensions.positive_anchor: Evidence verifies what actually ran, not what could have run.
dimensions.complete_chain_numerator: n_02 = decisions whose every applicable TR02 link is verified
dimensions.complete_chain_denominator: N_02 = all decisions in the neutral observer inventory that require a TR02 chain

dimensions.unit: Each decision requiring an observable state or artifact outcome record.
dimensions.positive_anchor: Evidence connects the decision to the observed effect; hash equality alone is not semantic correctness or safety.
dimensions.complete_chain_numerator: n_03 = decisions whose every required TR03 effect link is verified
dimensions.complete_chain_denominator: N_03 = all inventoried decisions requiring an outcome record under the frozen schema

dimensions.unit: Each actual repair attempt reconciled from independent change and event records.
dimensions.positive_anchor: The complete trigger-to-change-to-revalidation-to-result chain is independently resolvable, whether the repair passes or fails.
dimensions.complete_chain_numerator: n_04 = repair attempts whose every required TR04 link is verified
dimensions.complete_chain_denominator: N_04 = all actual repair attempts in the reconciled neutral inventory
dimensions.zero_repair_rule: N/A only when independent evidence verifies zero actual repairs; an empty repair log is not sufficient.

dimensions.unit: Each predeclared requirement and each inventoried in-scope change, reported as separate forward and reverse views.
dimensions.positive_anchor: Semantic requirement-to-artifact-to-evidence and change-to-requirement relationships are verified; code presence or a test name is insufficient.
dimensions.aggregation_rule: Never average or collapse forward and reverse rates.

dimensions.unit: Each predeclared artifact-audit or replay target.
dimensions.positive_anchor: A non-author assessor exercises the target and retains the receipt, agreement, or disagreement.
dimensions.attempt_accounting: Report attempted and not-attempted targets separately; non-attempt is not N/A.

scoring.binary_link_rule: A required link is 1 only when exact source/version, claimed relationship, and supporting locator are independently resolved; otherwise 0 with one primary missingness reason.
scoring.complete_chain_formula: For dimension d, N_d = |{u in U_d : applicable(u)=true}| and n_d = |{u in U_d : applicable(u)=true and every link in L_d(u) is verified}|. Report n_d/N_d only when inventory_complete=true and N_d>0.
scoring.per_link_formula: Optional only: l_d/m_d where l_d is the count of verified required links and m_d is the count of applicable required links across the same frozen units. It is not complete-chain coverage.
scoring.zero_denominator: Report N/A only with independently verified non-applicability. For TR04, this is independently verified zero actual repair attempts.
scoring.outcome_separation: Record actual outcome independently as PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, STAGE_NOT_REACHED, OUT_OF_SCOPE, or MISSING. Traceability does not imply success.
scoring.six_dimension_aggregation: Do not average TR01-TR06, primary time, defect outcomes, or audit burden into one score.

missingness.incomplete_inventory: coverage=INDETERMINATE; disclose observed counts and the inventory gap; do not publish a complete-looking percentage.
missingness.stage_not_reached: Record verified predecessor/guard and stage reason. It can satisfy a status-explanation link but never makes a later check executed or passed.
missingness.empty_log: An empty trace or repair log cannot establish zero activity.
missingness.mandatory_not_attempted: A mandatory audit/replay or validation stage not attempted is not N/A.

reliability.assessors: At least two assessors who did not generate the traces or implement the artifact.
reliability.pre_adjudication: Preserve each assessor's ratings and evidence locators before adjudication; calculate reliability before consensus.
reliability.measure: Nominal Krippendorff alpha for binary/status labels where estimable, with uncertainty where estimable.
reliability.undefined_policy: No variation or inadequate support is UNDEFINED or NOT_ESTIMABLE, never perfect reliability.
reliability.blinding: Blind arm/model labels where feasible; record access and blinding failures.
reliability.nested_units: Links are nested within decisions, repairs, requirements, targets, and runs; do not treat all links as independent study samples.
reliability.current_status: No pilot or reliability estimate was executed for this proposal.

controls.separate_accounting: Malformed or inapplicable controls are retained separately.
controls.format_invariance: Semantic format changes should not change grades; no RDF, ontology triples, layout, or decorative fields are required.
controls.burden: Record assessor minutes per unit, evidence objects inspected, access failures, and instrumentation/intervention overhead symmetrically; burden is not a score.

primary_time.prospective_definition: Continuous task-clock seconds from receipt of the matched complete request/evidence to the first exact receipt passing every pre-frozen mandatory check; waiting, edits, tools, provider waits, and repairs stay on the clock.
primary_time.failed_or_unfinished_runs: Do not assign successful-completion times; disclose completion status for every assigned run.
primary_time.current_case_role: Descriptive wall-clock value from an older case, not a newly predeclared prospective metric and not model-only inference latency.

measurement_status.current_case: One operator-assisted Codex task; n=1; independent repeats=0; no matched comparator; no independently scored TR01-TR06 values.
measurement_status.known_integrity_evidence: 107/107 released file/hash bindings match (102 manifest entries plus 5 actual images); this is byte-integrity evidence, not an independent study, publisher approval, authenticity proof, or efficacy result.
measurement_status.dated_qa10: QA10 is a dated PASS under its then-current acceptance set.
measurement_status.newest_overall: The newer additive overall QA record is NOT_PASS; it must not be collapsed into the dated QA10 PASS.

nonclaims: No traceability percentage or dimension score is measured by this proposal.
No causal superiority, ontology necessity, faster development, repair improvement, correctness, safety, human/player benefit, or model-quality claim follows from the current case.
Six CLI invocations, test counts, fixture counts, or native turn contexts are not independent task-runs.
Jev/Gemini consultation is advisory and not independent gold or calibrated correctness.
107/107 file/hash integrity does not prove independent study, publisher approval, authenticity, or efficacy.
The project rubric is not certified by PROV, NASA, ACM, Hayes-Krippendorff, or JCGM; JCGM metrological traceability is not software evidence traceability.
